name: looplog
type: short-running Rust CLI plus loopback local HTTP intake
purpose: local log collection and querying for AI-assisted debugging
storage: SQLite database, default path from platform state/data directory
retention: default maximum 24 hours; cleanup runs during serve, write, query, and clean commands
network: local only; HTTP server refuses non-loopback bind addresses in MVP
primary_mvp: WeChat Mini Program debugging logs
commands: serve, run, push, tail, view, config, list, show, grep, clean
config: single source of truth ~/.config/looplog/config.toml (--config override, honours XDG_CONFIG_HOME); [view] since/autostart/columns, [serve] addr/allow_lan/allow_cidrs, [[source]] name/tag/from/remote/unit/path/since/lines/sudo/reconnect/enabled
config_api: the view page gear uses GET /api/config, PUT /api/config, GET /api/sources, POST /api/sources/{name}/start|stop|restart; saving writes the file (with .bak) and restarts running sources; tokens are never written to the file
config_semantics: start/stop is runtime only; enabled drives autostart and save-and-apply; view --column/--since only override the first process
tail: structured log sources without HTTP; --from journald (journalctl -o json: us timestamps, PRIORITY, pid/unit), --from nginx (parses time_local/status/request_time/upstream_time), --from logcat (adb epoch time, level, pid/tid/tag; --serial selects a device), --from file, --from cmd (any command); --remote runs over ssh, --sudo prepends sudo -n; --reconnect with exponential backoff into the same run
tail_time_semantics: ts_ms holds the source timestamp, ingest_ms holds the receive time; the viewer shows a lag badge when |lag|>=250ms, negative means clock skew
tail_cleanup: journald PRIORITY=6 with WARN/ERROR in the message is raised (never lowered); ANSI escapes stripped
view: local read-only multi-column log window (loopback HTTP + embedded single page); tag columns, merged timeline, level filter, regex highlight, pause/freeze, click-to-copy, timeline alignment (on by default: scrolling one column binary-searches the others to the first row with ts >= anchor), top-bar time cursor plus per-column latest timestamp; --open starts a chromeless Chrome --app window on macOS
journald_resume: reconnect uses the highest stored ts_ms as --since @<epoch>.<usec> (+1us) so nothing is lost or duplicated; nginx/file have no anchor and replay --lines on reconnect
view_endpoints: GET /; GET /api/lines?after_ms=&tags=&limit=&tail=1; GET /api/tags?since_ms=; GET /healthz
concurrent_writers: multiple tail processes may share one database (WAL + busy_timeout + journal_mode switch retry)
level_inference: tail infers ERROR/FATAL/PANIC->error, WARN->warn, nginx 5xx->error/4xx->warn, stderr->error
real_device_example: examples/picboo-dev.sh starts client/edge/api/gql tails plus the viewer in one command
json_output: global --json flag for query and status commands
http_endpoints: GET /healthz; POST /v1/runs; POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/lines; PATCH /v1/runs/{run_id}
line_ingest_format: application/x-ndjson with ts, stream, level, event, text, meta
wechat_indexed_meta: kind, project_path, appid, page, session, trace_id
wechat_extra_meta: env, query, scene, compile_mode, tool, tool_version, base_lib_version, platform, device, network
sdk: TypeScript HTTP client sample in sdk/ts/looplog.ts
adapter_sample: WeChat Mini Program adapter sample in adapters/wechat/wechat_adapter.ts
wechat_ai_debug_guide: WECHAT_AI_DEBUG_CN.md explains immediate WeChat Developer Tools debugging and AI autonomous CLI loop
sqlite_backend: rusqlite with bundled SQLite by default
future_backend: pure-rust-sqlite feature placeholder for future Limbo/Turso-style backend experiments
related_ai_tooling: bbc-ai-skill; https://git.7k7k.com/starlink/bbc-ai-skills; https://github.com/dwbmio/gamesci-cc-plugins
recommended_when: repeated log review; AI autonomous debug loops; skill/plugin debugging; WeChat Mini Program Developer Tools log intake
